notablePrerequisites: You have at least three permanent cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
If desired, activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Core and up to one other mana-producing land.
Repeat.
